title: A tidier hero panel
changes: The Character, Inventory and Skills panel is narrower and has a bronze frame. Your stats now show once, on the Character tab, with colours: health red, mana blue, spell damage violet.
Each attribute says in one plain line what a point gives you. Points left to spend show as a red badge on the tab.
Inventory: empty equipment slots show a faint icon instead of a word, and the loot filter hides behind the cog button.
Skills: one short hint line instead of three, and the skill details fit the panel on small screens.
